usage.callShape: POST https://cnvrt.ing/api/transcribe with JSON body {url, includeTimestamps?, language?, enhanceAccuracy?}
usage.outputShape: body.transcription (string), body.success, body.jobId, body.language, body.duration, body.wordCount, body.timestamps[]{start,end,text} (when includeTimestamps:true)
quirks: Host cnvrt.ing is unreachable as of 2026-06-08: DNS does not resolve (connection timed out, no servers reachable) and HTTP returns 000 after a 15-30s timeout.
Control host google.com returned HTTP 200 in 0.2s from the same sandbox, confirming the network is fine and the failure is host-side.
qa-pay returned classification 'wallet-error' / 'provider request failed: fetch failed' with paid:false on two attempts — no USDC was spent because the connection never established.
Earlier probe (2026-06-01) showed a 402 (payable); the service has since gone offline.
usage.guide: This endpoint is currently dead. As of 2026-06-08 cnvrt.ing does not resolve via DNS and all requests time out (HTTP 000), confirmed against a working control host. When live, the documented call is POST https://cnvrt.ing/api/transcribe with JSON body {"url":"<media URL>"} (optional includeTimestamps, language ISO-639-1, enhanceAccuracy), paid via x402, and the result text would be at body.transcription with metadata at body.duration/wordCount and timestamp segments at body.timestamps[]. Do not call until reachability is re-confirmed.
